_comment: Synaptics CTS 0.0 generic sensor module. Assets are resolved from the installed synaptics_tactile_newton package, not from this extension.
description: Synaptics Capacitive Tactile Sensor, generic module, 52 square-grid force areas
_sensing_shape_pattern_comment: Matches the 3-digit force-area colliders only. A looser '*/forceArea_*' also catches the importer's forceArea_NNN_visual twins and silently doubles the taxel count.
_force_max_n_comment: Per-taxel saturation force [N]. The press axis is NOT set here: it comes from the taxel map's shared axis, which overrides any sensing_axis passed to CTSSensor.
_static_mount_comment: The baked USD carries PhysicsCollisionAPI without RigidBodyAPI, so its force areas load as static colliders. That matters: under OpenUSD < 26.5 the parallel physics parse corrupts the heap when one rigid body owns many colliders, and this module has 52. Static colliders are unaffected at any count. A rigid-body / robot-link mount needs OpenUSD >= 26.5, arriving with Newton 1.5.0.
_asset_units_comment: The baked USD is authored in metres with metersPerUnit=1.0; spawn.py scales only for stages that are not metre-based.
